cases.source:
events = []
class C:
    def __len__(self): return 2
    def __getitem__(self, i): return i
c = C()
c.__reversed__ = lambda: 42
try:
    value = list(reversed(c))
    result = ('ok', value, events)
except Exception as error:
    result = (type(error).__name__, str(error), error.args, events)

cases.source:
events = []
Proxy = type(type.__dict__)
class C(dict): pass
c = C(a=1, b=2)
c.__reversed__ = lambda: iter([9])
p = Proxy(c)
try:
    value = list(reversed(p))
    result = ('ok', value, events)
except Exception as error:
    result = (type(error).__name__, str(error), error.args, events)
